_note: Name-facts for Tuvalu (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region
of the same id, written later, never shows a town's sentences.

en: An atoll whose airstrip is also where people play football and sleep on hot nights.
Tuvalu’s internet domain, .tv, earns the country a large part of its income.
The atoll’s highest point is only about 4.5 m above the sea.
it: Un atollo la cui pista d’atterraggio serve anche per giocare a calcio e per dormire nelle notti calde.
Il dominio internet di Tuvalu, .tv, porta al paese buona parte delle sue entrate.
Il punto più alto dell’atollo è solo a circa 4,5 m sopra il mare.
